steps.title: The pulse
steps.html: Everything loops in cycles. s("bd*4") plays the bass drum four times per cycle: a four-on-the-floor kick. setcpm(124/4) gives 31 bars a minute, which is 124 BPM.
steps.listen: A steady kick on every beat. The word bd lights up each time it plays.

steps.title: Claps on 2 and 4
steps.html: Each line that starts with $: is a separate layer, and all layers play together. ~ is a rest, so "~ cp ~ cp" puts a clap on beats 2 and 4.
steps.listen: The clap answering the kick, the backbone of almost every dance track.

steps.title: Open hats on the off-beat
steps.html: "[~ oh]*4" repeats "rest, open hat" four times, which puts the open hat on every off-beat. .gain(.4) keeps it quieter than the drums.
steps.listen: The hat between every kick. This is where house gets its bounce.
steps.code:
setcpm(124/4)
$: s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909")
$: s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909")
+ $: s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.4)

steps.title: Human feel
steps.html: A drum machine hits every note at the same volume. rand.range(.25, .7) gives each hat a random volume, and .degradeBy(.15) randomly drops 15% of the hits.
steps.listen: Sixteen hats that never repeat exactly. Delete .degradeBy to hear the difference.
steps.code:
setcpm(124/4)
$: s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909")
$: s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909")
$: s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.4)
+ $: s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909")
+   .gain(rand.range(.25, .7))
+   .degradeBy(.15)

steps.title: A fill every 4th bar
steps.html: < > picks a different item each bar. In bar 4 the kick stops halfway while the toms roll down, and a crash marks the start of each new phrase.
steps.listen: Every fourth bar, the drop-out and the tom roll that tells you a new phrase is coming.
steps.code:
setcpm(124/4)
+ $: s("<bd*4 bd*4 bd*4 [bd bd ~ ~]>").bank("RolandTR909")
$: s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909")
$: s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.4)
$: s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909")
  .gain(rand.range(.25, .7)).degradeBy(.15)
+ $: s("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ [ht mt] [lt lt]]>").bank("RolandTR909")
+ $: s("<cr ~ ~ ~>").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.5)
